queries.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT 'before' AS period, DATE '2024-01-29' AS s, DATE '2024-03-04' AS e UNION ALL SELECT 'after', DATE '2024-06-17', DATE '2024-09-01'), t AS (SELECT CAST(order_date AS DATE) AS d FROM supplier_delivery) SELECT w.period, CAST(COUNT(t.d) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(date_diff('day', w.s, w.e) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM w LEFT JOIN t ON t.d >= w.s AND t.d < w.e GROUP BY w.period, w.s, w.e

WITH w AS (SELECT 'before' AS period, DATE '2024-01-29' AS s, DATE '2024-03-04' AS e UNION ALL SELECT 'after', DATE '2024-06-17', DATE '2024-09-01'), t AS (SELECT CAST(order_date AS DATE) AS d FROM supplier_delivery WHERE supplier_id = 'SUP-001' AND CAST(is_late AS INTEGER) = 1) SELECT w.period, CAST(COUNT(t.d) AS DOUBLE) / CAST(date_diff('day', w.s, w.e) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM w LEFT JOIN t ON t.d >= w.s AND t.d < w.e GROUP BY w.period, w.s, w.e

WITH w AS (SELECT 'before' AS period, DATE '2024-01-29' AS s, DATE '2024-03-04' AS e UNION ALL SELECT 'after', DATE '2024-06-17', DATE '2024-09-01'), t AS (SELECT CAST(ss.date AS DATE) AS d, ss.value AS v FROM stock_snapshot ss WHERE ss.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM product WHERE supplier_id = 'SUP-001')) SELECT w.period, CAST(AVG(CASE WHEN t.v <= 0 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS DOUBLE) AS value FROM w JOIN t ON t.d >= w.s AND t.d < w.e GROUP BY w.period
